seen.front: Pip's head tips toward the ground, with a dark open mouth under the muzzle and straight front legs beneath him.
seen.three_quarter: Pip lowers his head and dark mouth toward the ground while all four legs support his raised body and tail.
seen.side: Pip points his muzzle and dark mouth down, keeps his legs planted, and holds his tail up.
seen.back: Pip's head faces away, his legs stand square, and his raised tail covers the center of his back with no pink shape under the belly.
seen.strip: Pip keeps his head low and tail raised through the loop, with small head bobs and planted-looking paws.
seen.rest: The before and after rest pictures look the same, with Pip's open pink-tongued smile and upright tail.
